title: 🚔 Multiple Public Safety Jobs in Delaware County, PA - NewsBreak
text:
12 hours ago Delaware County’s colleges are hiring for key public safety roles this month. If you’re steady under pressure and care about keeping people safe, these openings are worth a look.
Community Resource Officer Patrol/Communications Employer: Swarthmore College
Location: Swarthmore, PA
Type: Full-time (3rd shift, 7 PM–7 AM)
Pay: $24.34/hour
Join Swarthmore’s Public Safety team to patrol the scenic 425-acre campus, respond to emergencies, and manage communications. The college offers strong benefits, retirement contributions, and paid training in CPR, de-escalation, and more.
Campus Safety Officer, 3rd Shift Employer: Widener University
Location: Chester, PA
Type: Full-time (12 AM–8 AM)
This role keeps Widener’s campus secure through patrols, emergency response, and community engagement. It’s a good fit for someone with solid communication skills and a calm approach to problem-solving.
